plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Three office games in your IDE: Turkish Wordle, Higher / Lower and live drawing rooms. Connect to your office's Arcade Machine LAN server for shared daily challenges and live leaderboards.
plugin.change-notes: Buttons have clearer surfaces, edges and interaction feedback while keeping the simple layout. Drawing players can reveal a random letter to everyone in their room with Harf aç. The server controls the per-turn limit (default 2) and keeps at least one letter hidden. Letter hints require server 0.3.3; earlier servers still run existing games.
